Jesus answered and said unto her,
Whosoever drinketh of this water shall thirst again:

fullText: 13 Jesus answered and said unto her, Whosoever drinketh of this water shall thirst again:
slides: 13 Jesus answered and said unto her, Whosoever drinketh of this water shall thirst again:

verses.text: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.

fullText: 16 For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.
